mission.earthObserver.title: Earth Observer
mission.earthObserver.brief: Put an imaging satellite into low Earth orbit and deliver enough data to meet the science team's requirements.
agency.usa.name: United States
agency.usa.description: Large budget and the full range of launchers. Nothing is cheap, but there is room for mistakes.
agency.india.name: India
agency.india.description: Small budget, but cheap launchers, engines and solar panels. Heavy launcher is not available.
agency.esa.name: Europe
agency.esa.description: Average budget, with discounted antennas and science instruments.
ui.setup.title: Choose the agencies (up to {max})
ui.setup.hint: Agencies take turns at one screen and design their own spacecraft for the same mission.
ui.marginHint.dv: Speed change the engine can produce. It must be enough to reach the orbit.
ui.marginHint.energy: The battery must keep the spacecraft alive in the planet's shadow.
ui.marginHint.link: Data you can send down per orbit must cover what the camera collects.
ui.marginHint.science: Smallest visible detail. Smaller is sharper, and science needs at most the required value.
ui.marginHint.mass: The launcher must be able to lift the whole spacecraft with its propellant.
ui.marginHint.budget: Total cost of the spacecraft and the launcher must fit the budget.
ui.waitHint: Waiting makes new modules cheaper, but the deadline gets closer and data from a late launch is worth less.
ui.result.title: Mission results
ui.result.missed: {agency} missed the deadline and contributed nothing.
